ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
With the increasing severity of environmental issues and the advancement of battery technology, zero-emission pure electric vehicles have gradually entered our lives and are rapidly developing. There is a type of super electric vehicle that only requires a 30-second to 1-minute charging interval while passengers board, enabling it to travel 3 to 5 kilometers. Suppose there is a super electric vehicle with a mass of \( m = 2 \times 10^{3} \, \mathrm{kg} \), a rated power of \( P = 80 \, \mathrm{kW} \), traveling on a flat, horizontal road, experiencing a resistance force that is 0.1 times the weight of the vehicle, with \( g \) taken as \( 10 \, \mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2} \).

1. When a super electric car accelerates at its rated power, what is the acceleration of the super electric car when $v=10\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$?
2. If a super electric car starts from rest and accelerates at a constant rated power, reaching its maximum speed after 40 seconds, what is the displacement of the super electric car during this process?

For part 2, the maximum speed occurs when the driving force balances resistance, so P = f v_max, giving v_max = 80000/2000 = 40 m/s. Over 40 s, the input energy is Pt = 80000×40 = 3.2×10^6 J. Suppose there is a super electric vehicle with a mass of \( m = 2 \times 10^{3} \, \mathrm{kg} \), a rated power of \( P = 80 \, \mathrm{kW} \), traveling on a flat, horizontal road, experiencing a resistance force that is 0.1 times the weight of the vehicle, with \( g \) taken as \( 10 \, \mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2} \).

1. When a super electric car accelerates at its rated power, what is the acceleration of the super electric car when $v=10\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$?
2. If a super electric car starts from rest and accelerates at a constant rated power, reaching its maximum speed after 40 seconds, what is the displacement of the super electric car during this process?

Suppose there is a super electric vehicle with a mass of \( m = 2 \times 10^{3} \, \mathrm{kg} \), a rated power of \( P = 80 \, \mathrm{kW} \), traveling on a flat, horizontal road, experiencing a resistance force that is 0.1 times the weight of the vehicle, with \( g \) taken as \( 10 \, \mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2} \). 1. When a super electric car accelerates at its rated power, what is the acceleration of the super electric car when $v=10\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$? 2. If a super electric car starts from rest and accelerates at a constant rated power, reaching its maximum speed after 40 seconds, what is the displacement of the super electric car during this process?
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: Given m = 2.0×10^3 kg, P = 80 kW = 8.0×10^4 W, g = 10 m/s^2. The resistance force is f = 0.1mg = 0.1×2000×10 = 2000 N. For part 1, at v = 10 m/s and rated power, P = F_drive v, so F_drive = P/v = 80000/10 = 8000 N. The net force is F_net = 8000 - 2000 = 6000 N, so a = F_net/m = 6000/2000 = 3 m/s^2. For part 2, the maximum speed occurs when the driving force balances resistance, so P = f v_max, giving v_max = 80000/2000 = 40 m/s. Over 40 s, the input energy is Pt = 80000×40 = 3.2×10^6 J. The kinetic energy at maximum speed is (1/2)mv_max^2 = 0.5×2000×40^2 = 1.6×10^6 J. Using Pt = (1/2)mv_max^2 + f s, we get s = (3.2×10^6 - 1.6×10^6)/2000 = 800 m.
